name: truing_dsp
description: Acoustic layers 2-4 ported from the research repository (SPEC 4.4.1, 9.2): Hann-windowed zero-padded FFT spectrum with parabolic refinement, prominence-based peak candidates, the INTERIM layer-3 selection rule (lowest strong peak in the f1 band, output marked presumed_fundamental), onset detection and window gating, and the four candidate tension models behind one interface. Framework-free float32 C11; every constant arrives as a parameter, never a literal.
